fusions.name: Shaken Oilskin
fusions.desc: Shakes the water off your oilskin in a 3-tile cone, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Waxed Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a length of waxed oilskin at an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 28 damage that ignores resistances, up to 1.3 times as much at full reach, and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shrugged Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you.

fusions.name: Beading Luck
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that lands on you is rolled again, and the second roll stands.
